## Senior AI leadership & delivery — with clear scope and outcomes

I help enterprises move from AI exploration to controlled implementation: identifying high-value automation opportunities, modernizing data and code stacks, integrating agents into existing workflows, and upgrading legacy code — while managing stakeholders across business, IT, data, legal, and security.

I work as **AI Automation Lead / Change Manager, Principal Consultant or AI Engineer** — depending on what the engagement needs. I lead and ship in production-scale environments, owning roadmaps and writing code, not slide decks.
